setting: You are all neighbours in the same residential building in Hong Kong, and you know each other from shared lifts, the lobby and the building's group chat for everyday matters.
opener: Ask whether the eighth-floor lift is working, since she has just come off a late shift.

Wing.knows: You know Fai as the older man in the building who keeps an eye on the lobby, and you know Leo as the quiet young man on your floor who works from home.
Wing.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when a building matter needs sorting or you've noticed something in the lobby.

Fai.knows: You know Wing as the nurse on the eighth floor who is always polite in the lift, and you know Leo as the young software developer on the twelfth floor who sometimes gets his parcels delivered to the lobby.
Fai.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something needs checking in the building, such as a parcel left in the lobby or a lift problem.

Leo.knows: You know Wing as the nurse on the eighth floor who is friendly in the lift, and you know Fai as the security supervisor who looks after the lobby and sometimes lets you know when a parcel has arrived.
Leo.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to pass on something practical like a parcel or a building notice.

private_lines.Wing: You work as a nurse at a public hospital in Kowloon, rotating between day and night shifts. You live in a flat on the eighth floor with your husband and your teenage son, and your days revolve around getting to the hospital on time and fitting in family meals and errands when you're off.
private_lines.Fai: You work part-time as a security supervisor at an office building a few stops away, mostly on evening shifts. You live on the ground floor of this building with your wife, who runs a small tailoring shop nearby, and you spend your free days walking, reading the newspaper and doing light chores around the flat.
private_lines.Leo: You work as a software developer, mostly from a desk in your studio flat on the twelfth floor, on flexible hours that often run late. You live alone, and your days are spent coding, going to the gym in the afternoon and ordering in for dinner.

text: Anyone know if lift B at 8/F is working? Came back from hospital and it just wont come up from G. Pressed it like 3 times
Lift B has the out of order sticker on it since this morning. Lift A is working ok
Ok thanks. The one that was making the noise?
Yes that one. Technician coming tomorrow morning, I put a notice up in the lobby too
Lol I heard it stop around 11, thought it was just me being slow with the deploy
Tbh I've been taking lift A anyway
Leo your parcel is at the lobby desk, the box from lazada. I'll be gone for my shift at 18:00 so collect before 9pm or ask the night guard (his name is Kwok)
Thanks, will grab it after gym
Lift B still out. Technician said morning, sorry
No worries. 12 floors is basically cardio anyway 😂
Did anyone else get the buzz about the bins on 3/F being left open again
Nvm, I'll just message the chat when I see it tomorrow
